notes: PvP Pad v4 on Robinhood Chain (4663), fresh from identity-md-launches/launch-1832-donotbuy @a9a48cb4b458f35160da7ec0693e4b422be684ca. Contracts only: deploy these five applications atomically in order with zero ETH; no token supply, name, symbol, pool, hook or distributor is created at deployment. Templates are sealed. All tokens including PvP are later created by the pad. Owner and dev are both $owner (the supplied launch owner 0x5b95a971b4583a5f011e9da082acdd679b870d06). PadLiquidity(poolManager, pad, imd) takes exactly three static addresses and no pool-id argument. PoolManager is inherited configuration; IMD is the specified bridged 18-decimal token. Constructors call only earlier manifest contracts and no external dependency; no configuration calls follow deployment. Later openPad(salt), owner-only before day 30 then permissionless, deploys the permission-bit-mined hook and genesis clones. Games and king pull IMD through PvPPad from their caller only. Public carry/burn donations pull from the donor. Exact receipt checks reject short pulls and empty ERC20 returns are supported. Unit starts at 1 IMD; only owner may change it between 0.1 and 10 IMD, with an event. Games snapshot unit; king first-bid minimum and burn cap use current unit. Entry 0.5 unit, roll 1 unit (90/7/2/1 curve/pot/burn/tip); virtual reserve 400 units against 1 billion coins, 800 million sold at 1600 units; finalizer 0.5% max 2 units. Alive-at-bail seats count only for the five-seat funded-release threshold; net-curve caps remain. After finalize, direct coin/IMD graduation at final curve price: sorted currencies, fee 10000, tick spacing 200, PadHook, permanent full-range LP, IMD dust donated, excess coins burned, token unlocked atomically. No conversion, anchor, escrow, timeout or native route exists. Burn buys PvP with bucket IMD in one hop, at most 8 current units per ten minutes, 1% price limit and partial fills. King first bid at least 4 current units, then +10% after one hour; refunds and fees in IMD/coins, rejected payouts claimable without blocking batches. Reign stamps, raffle, carry rules and upkeep gas caps retained. If IMD stops transferring, the pad IMD waits. See docs/AUDIT.md, docs/TEST-REPORT.md, docs/VERIFY.md and ADAPTATION.md. Legal review and an independent audit are required before public launch. No deployment, broadcast or RPC performed.
